raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

With compact ragged verify (`SGLANG_RAGGED_VERIFY_MODE=compact`), `DecodeCudaGraphRunner` captures a token tier more than once when there are several attention graph variants (for example the DSv4.1 candidate graphs `candidate_unfiltered` / `candidate_filtered`) or several PD-mux streams. Each capture calls `_capture_ragged_verify_layout`, which allocated a new `RaggedVerifyLayout` and replaced `_captured_ragged_layouts[num_tokens]`. At replay, `_stage_ragged_verify_layout` copies the live `verify_lens` / `qo_indptr` only into that registered layout, which belongs to the last capture. Graphs from the earlier captures still read the layout they were captured with. That layout holds synthetic capture offsets, and replay no longer refreshes it.

A graph that reads an earlier capture's layout tensors directly computes with the wrong offsets whenever the live layout differs from the capture-time one. On current main, PD-mux with the TRT-LLM MLA backend is exposed: its ragged verify path pads and unpads queries with the captured `verify_lens` / `qo_indptr` inside the graph. For DSv4.1 target verify on current main the defect is latent, because its backend copies the live layout into its own buffers outside the graph. The ragged Engram hashing and `token_req_indices` in #40567 read `qo_indptr` inside the DSv4.1 verify graph; with them, the `candidate_unfiltered` graphs map tokens to the wrong requests.

I measured an A/B on DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash (TP4, 4x RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell, SM120, DSpark gamma 5, compact verify, #40567 applied) with an earlier revision of this fix, which copied the live layout into each capture instead of sharing one layout per tier. I compared the log-prob of each generated token with a plain prefill of the same text:

- Without the fix, per-token differences reached 14.4 nats. At temperature 1, 9 of 32 streams looped to the length cap.
- With the fix, the maximum difference was 0.79-0.86 nats, and none of the 32 streams looped or hit the cap.

Eager verify was correct in both builds.

## Modifications

`_capture_ragged_verify_layout` creates the layout once per token tier and returns the same object for later captures of that tier. Every graph of the tier now captures the tensors that replay refreshes.

## Accuracy Tests

- `TestRaggedVerifyLayoutPerTier` (CPU, `test/registered/unit/model_executor/runner/test_decode_cuda_graph_runner.py`) calls the capture-layout helper twice for tier 24 with two variant labels, stages a live layout, and checks both returned layouts' `qo_indptr_device` / `verify_lens` against the live padded layout. On main the first layout keeps its synthetic offsets (7 of 9 `qo_indptr` entries differ).
- The end-to-end A/B in Motivation (earlier revision of the fix).

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Not benchmarked. The replay staging code is unchanged; capture reuses one registered layout per token tier across attention variants and PD-mux streams.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

Developed with AI assistance.

nodes.body:
We confirm this bug and this fix on AMD MI355X (gfx950).

We found it while we evaluated DSpark compact verify on DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash (TP4, 4x MI355X, DSpark block size 5, verify width 6, compact verify, with #40567 applied). Compact verify sampled from a flatter distribution than the target.

**What we saw without the fix**

- Inside the compact target-verify CUDA graph, `low_ratio_req_indices` was `[slot, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0]` for one request with 6 verify tokens, in every step. Only the first token mapped to the live request. The other five mapped to request slot 0. Positions and out-cache locations were correct.
- The first request after server start (the warm-up) mapped correctly. Every later request mapped as above.
- A 1-token request, such as the `/health` probe, produced a NaN target logit row.

**A/B on one tree, with and without the change in this PR**

Target logits at each verify step, compared with a target-only prefill of the same prefix and draft tokens (greedy, 6 prompts of about 1.1k tokens):

| | top-1 agreement | log-prob slope | \|diff\| > 0.5 nats |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| static verify | 90.4% | 0.995 | 32.8% |
| compact | 69.7% | 0.845 | 56.0% |
| compact + this fix | 90.2% | 1.006 | 31.9% |

Static is the baseline. The generation servers run `--enable-decoder-swa-bounded-replay` and the scoring server does not.

Sampling at temperature 1.0 and top_p 1.0 (384 prompts at concurrency 64, up to 1024 tokens), scored by a target-only server:

| | mean target log-prob per token | tokens below -5 per 1k | reached 1024 tokens |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| target only | -0.435 | 8.1 | 52% |
| static verify | -0.427 | 7.9 | 49% |
| compact | -1.107 | 63.3 | 26% |
| compact + this fix | -0.415 | 7.8 | 51% |

Our local fix was the same change as this PR (one layout per token tier). Our CPU test of `_capture_ragged_verify_layout` behaves like `TestRaggedVerifyLayoutPerTier`: without the fix, the first variant keeps its capture layout.

#40567 makes the DSv4.1 verify graph read `qo_indptr`, so landing this PR first keeps compact verify correct when #40567 lands.

🚀 `1-gpu-h100` (1 test): ✅ [View workflow run](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/37870663547) <!--rrt:0:done-->
```
cd test/ && python3 registered/core/test_basic_sanity_dspark.py
```

🚀 `ubuntu-latest` (1 test): ✅ [View workflow run](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/37870673884) <!--rrt:1:done-->
```
cd test/ && python3 registered/unit/model_executor/runner/test_decode_cuda_graph_runner.py
```

files.patch:
@@ -653,6 +653,9 @@ def _capture_ragged_verify_layout(self, num_tokens: int):
             return None
         if envs.SGLANG_TEST_RAGGED_VERIFY_FORCE_UNIFORM_CAPTURE.get():
             return None
+        layout = self._captured_ragged_layouts.get(num_tokens)
+        if layout is not None:
+            return layout
         from sglang.srt.speculative.ragged_verify import (
             RaggedVerifyLayout,
             build_capture_verify_lens,

@@ -246,5 +246,42 @@ def test_noop_when_flag_unset(self):
                 )
 
 
+class TestRaggedVerifyLayoutPerTier(CustomTestCase):
+    """Every graph variant of a token tier must replay the staged live layout."""
+
+    def test_replay_stages_layout_of_every_variant(self):
+        import torch
+
+        from sglang.srt.speculative.ragged_verify import RaggedVerifyLayout
+
+        runner = DecodeCudaGraphRunner.__new__(DecodeCudaGraphRunner)
+        runner.ragged_verify_mode = True
+        runner.max_bs = 8
+        runner.captured_req_width = 6
+        runner.capture_num_tokens = [6, 12, 24, 48]
+        runner.device = "cpu"
+        runner._captured_ragged_layouts = {}
+        with mock.patch.dict(
+            os.environ, {"SGLANG_TEST_RAGGED_VERIFY_FORCE_UNIFORM_CAPTURE": "0"}
+        ):
+            captured = {
+                variant: runner._capture_ragged_verify_layout(24)
+                for variant in ("candidate_unfiltered", "candidate_filtered")
+            }
+
+        live = RaggedVerifyLayout.from_verify_lens_device(
+            verify_lens=torch.tensor([6, 1, 6, 3, 6], dtype=torch.int32),
+            graph_num_tokens=24,
+        )
+        expected = live.padded_to_bucket(padded_bs=8, cap=6)
+        runner._stage_ragged_verify_layout(live, 24)
+        for variant, layout in captured.items():
+            with self.subTest(variant=variant):
+                torch.testing.assert_close(
+                    layout.qo_indptr_device, expected.qo_indptr_device
+                )
+                torch.testing.assert_close(layout.verify_lens, expected.verify_lens)
+
+
 if __name__ == "__main__":
     unittest.main()
